description: NHFLOW 2D wave flume from rest (k = omega = 0, no discharge inflow), 5th-order Stokes wave, relaxation zones, k-omega without the eddy viscosity limiter (A 564 0): the length-scale limit l <= kappa h bounds nu_t = k/omega while omega is still ~ 0. Before the limit held with A 564 0, nu_t was 1.7e6 m2/s in the second step.
covers: start of k-omega from k = omega = 0
